question: By what means—described as mere knowledge and as what has been heard—is the result attained, addressed to the fair-faced one?
premises: It is characterized as mere knowledge.
It is also characterized as what has been heard.
inference: By mere knowledge, and by what has been heard, the attainment comes about, O fair-faced one.
uncertainties: The specific attainment is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: By this mere knowledge, and by what has been heard, O fair-faced one.
